title: End of day, the book 'More Than Mere Survival'
summary: Hughes thanks her for a marathon session and she names a 1980 book that profiles her; he calls her a community activist.

Yeah, the title of the book is 'More Than Mere Survival' and Jane Seskin is the authoress and it's conversations with women over 65.
